scope: A new DEV-only calibration experiment for one already trained and independently audited new640 model. No training, new features, data selection, model averaging, test access or primary change.
motivation: The original unconstrained max33 threshold has min33 above .90 but fails the unchanged .02 old-natural system-F1 loss floor by about .0006247. Its failed trial, records, threshold and selection remain immutable.
grid: Exactly the original unique union: 199 F64 linspace(.001,.999), 301 quantiles of the concatenated existing new-model old/C4/public DEV F32 system probabilities, and 1.000001. Preserve distinct F64 candidates even when they share one effective F32 comparison. No threshold expansion or full-event search.
selection: First reject any threshold failing absolute min33>=.90, the original exact <=.05 FPR feasibility in nine groups, any of five strict min33 improvements (>1e-12), or any of eight original guards plus original-savedGPU. Among the remaining thresholds maximize min33, then old5 mean system F1, then prefer the smaller original F64 threshold. No admissible threshold means no candidate and no fallback.

unchanged_data.public_truth: system/user/assistant only; CoT/tool recall remains N/A

tau_invariant_metrics: Five-class argmax accuracy, per-role recalls/confusion, macro-F1, NLL, system AUROC/AP and all existing model/feature/hash evidence are bound to the original audited new-max33 record. Only threshold-dependent binary metrics and system detection by role change.
declaration: Root must publish the final source/design and explicitly --declare before any probability array read. Freeze exact upstream actual-audit/complete/protocol/model/records/controls/zero/source hashes, explicit row-table and probability SHA certificates, and package versions. Declaration does not open probability files or materialize row tables. No growing inventory/global verifier.
execution: Only root may --actual after declaration and source review. Verify the frozen bytes, load the same three DEV probability arrays with exact sample order, re-establish the original max33 threshold/objective, then evaluate the fixed grid under all unchanged constraints. Write a separate immutable ledger/result; never edit the prior trial, helper, builder, model, threshold or primary.
limitations: This method was proposed after examining reused development results. Constraint-aware calibration is additional developer selection, not a training or five-class improvement and not independent confirmation. A successful DEV calibration still requires genuinely fresh C4 and public-natural confirmation before goal completion. All original 14 records and two zero controls remain read-only.
